lines: What is one thing can you do for yourself this week to celebrate?
C R E AT E  A  R O U T I N E  T H AT  I N C O R P O R AT E S
S O M E /A L L  O F  T H E  I T E M S  F R O M  Y O U R  L I S T S .
Pick one or two items from each list and do them every day
Make a schedule that includes time for your self-care activities
Add new items to your lists as you think of them
Stick to your schedule as much as possible
Take a break when you need it – if you’re feeling overwhelmed,
take a few days off from your schedule to relax and recharge
Be flexible – if something comes up that you can’t do,
don’t stress about it, just try to do it another day.
Y O U R  S U C C E S S E S
– each time you stick to your schedule, give yourself a pat on the back!
